news.text: Portland's Damian Lillard played at Milwaukee for the first time since the Bucks waived him in 2025 and gave Bucks fans a taste of what they're missing by scoring a season-high 33 points in the Trail Blazers' 124-114 victory on Thursday night.

news.title: Doc Rivers says he apologized to Giannis Antetokounmpo while clarifying critique
news.text: Doc Rivers said he reached out to apologize to Giannis Antetokounmpo for questioning the Miami Heat star's basketball IQ, saying he meant more that the force Antetokounmpo plays with can get "in the way of his feel."
